{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Rock| trainername=Olivia| pokemonname=Lycanroc| jtrainername=ライチ| jpokemonname=ルガルガン| tmtrainername=Lychee| tmpokemonname=Lugarugan| gender=Unknown{{tt|*|Confirmed male in the games only}}| ability={{a|Keen Eye}}/{{a|Vital Spirit}}{{tt|*|Confirmed in the games only}}| image=[[File:Olivia Lycanroc.png|250px]]| caption=Olivia's Lycanroc| location=Unknown| prevonum=744| evo1num=745| evolution=1| firstevoep=SM031| firstevoname=The Island Whisperer!| firstevonametiming=Prior to| firststagename=Rockruff| secondstagename=Lycanroc| numeps1=an unknown amount of| epnum=SM031| epname=The Island Whisperer!| current=[[Party|With Olivia]]| java1=N/A| java2=[[Yūji Ueda]]| enva2=[[Mike Liscio]]| }} '''Olivia's Lycanroc''' (Japanese: '''ライチのルガルガン''' ''Lychee's Lugarugan'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Olivia]] in the {{pkmn|animated series}}, {{pkmn|games}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. In the animated series, Olivia owns a Midday Form Lycanroc, while in the games and in [[Pokémon Adventures]], she owns a Midnight Form Lycanroc. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== =====Pre-series===== When {{p|Lycanroc}} was still a {{p|Rockruff}}, it ran away from [[Olivia]] and [[Evolution|evolved]] into Lycanroc before returning to her. Later, Lycanroc was used in Olivia's {{pkmn|battle}} against {{an|Kiawe}} and his {{TP|Kiawe|Turtonator}}, where it was defeated, earning Kiawe [[Kiawe's grandfather|his grandfather]]'s [[Z-Ring]] and [[Firium Z]]. ====={{aniseries|SM}}===== [[File:Lycanroc protecting Ash Rockruff.png|thumb|250px|Lycanroc protecting Rockruff]] Lycanroc debuted in ''[[SM031|The Island Whisperer!]]'' to help [[Kiawe's Charizard]] when it was struggling to deal with an out of control {{p|Tauros}}. Lycanroc quickly calms the Wild Bull Pokémon down. It is later seen getting acquainted with [[Ash's Rockruff]]. Afterwards, it helps fend off a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Bruxish}}. In ''[[SM036|Trials and Determinations!]]'', Lycanroc was used during Olivia's [[Island challenge|grand trial]] battle against {{Ash}}, where it teamed up with {{p|Probopass}} to battle Ash's Rockruff and {{AP|Rowlet}}. Despite proving to be a formidable opponent with its strength and speed, Lycanroc was eventually defeated by Rockruff's {{m|Rock Throw}}. In ''[[SM037|Rising from the Ruins!]]'', after hearing about Rockruff's disappearance, Lycanroc left its {{pkmn|Trainer}} to go and find him. It eventually met up with [[Gladion's Lycanroc]] and took Rockruff to the [[Ruins of Life]], where they encountered {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Lele}}, who attacked them. Lycanroc later watched as Rockruff evolved into a {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Lycanroc|Dusk Form}} {{AP|Lycanroc}}. Afterwards, Lycanroc went back to Olivia. In ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]'', Lycanroc attended the wedding of {{an|Professor Kukui}} and {{an|Professor Burnet}} with Olivia. Lycanroc reappeared in ''[[SM075|Some Kind of Laziness!]]'' and ''[[SM080|Not Caving Under Pressure!]]'', during flashbacks. In ''[[SM090|Securing the Future!]]'', Lycanroc joined the rest of [[Alola]] in showering {{an|Necrozma}} with light so it could return to its {{form|Necrozma|true form}}. After it returned to its true form, it and Olivia used their [[Z-Move]] to shower Necrozma in a blinding amount of light. In ''[[SM103|Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!]]'', Olivia used Lycanroc in her battle against {{an|Brock}}. It went up against {{TP|Brock|Sudowoodo}}, but the battle was interrupted when {{TRT}} attempted to steal the Pokémon. Lycanroc was able to stop them when Brock and Olivia teamed up, allowing Lycanroc to use a heart-shaped {{m|Continental Crush}} against them. In ''[[SM140|Z-Move Showdown!]]'', Lycanroc was used to battle a {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Manalo Stadium Guzzlord|Guzzlord}} to prevent it from the destroying the [[Manalo Stadium]]. With a combination of Z-Moves, Lycanroc, among the other [[island kahuna]]s' Pokémon, managed to send the Guzzlord back into its [[Ultra Wormhole]]. ====Personality and characteristics==== Lycanroc is depicted as a caring Pokémon. For example, in ''[[SM037|Rising from the Ruins!]]'', it left its Trainer on its own accord to help Ash's Rockruff and defend it from {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Lele}}. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|rock||Olivia Lycanroc {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Accelerock|1=Rock Slide|2=Double Team|3=Drill Run}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Accelerock|1=Rock Slide|2=Double Team|3=Drill Run}}}} {{anmov|rock|Accelerock|SM031|The Island Whisperer!}} {{anmov|rock|Rock Slide|SM031|The Island Whisperer!}} {{anmov|normal|Double Team|SM103|Heart of Fire!
